newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork wins gas field contract from NAM.
newsitem.headline: Stork wins gas field contract from NAM.

text.p: Industrial systems and services group Stork NV said on Friday its Stork Engineers & Contractors unit had won a contract from oil and gas company NAM for design, purchase and project management services involved in developing a number of gas fields.

Stork said a maximum of five gas fields in the western part of the Netherlands were to be developed over a period of five years, estimating the value of the contract at some 30 million guilders if all five projects were realised.
NAM, short for the Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij B.V. and jointly owned by Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon, intends to sign framework contracts with two other parties, Stork said.
Stork did not name the other parties, a multidisciplinary building contractor and a supplier of integrated supervision and safety systems.
